verdict.rationale: Segment documents Functions, which run custom JavaScript inside the workspace to build your own sources and destinations. That places custom code in the pipeline, but the evidence never shows transforming, filtering, or enriching events in flight before they reach existing destinations. missing for 10: documented in-pipeline transformation/filtering of events bound for catalog destinations, enrichment capabilities, examples of event mutation logic, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can transform, filter, and enrich events in-pipeline with custom code or functions before they reach destinations

citations.quote: Functions let you create your own sources and destinations directly within your workspace to bring new types of data into Segment and send data to new tools with just a few lines of JavaScript - no additional infrastructure required.
